messages:
Elaine: FYI — Pegasus (client) is seeing a spike in 503s + h2 timeouts for dedicated pool B this morning. They're approaching SLA thresholds (p99 ~ 1.2s -> 2.6s). @Omar @Maya can you confirm if this looks like routing, a model-variant flapping, or infra? Need an owner + short-term workaround by EOD.

Omar: taking this. Reassigning to me to lead triage. What's the fastest repro you have? logs or a curl example?

Elaine: pasted minimal repro from the support ticket: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/pegasus/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"hello"}'` — returns 503 intermittently. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/t/PEG-887 (customer attached logs).

Maya: I'm checking pool B autoscale + recent infra deploys. I see increased tail latency on a subset of GPU nodes after yesterday's kernel bump. No model exceptions yet. Running KV-cache and OOM checks now.

SRE Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-pegasus-503. Pager rotated to Omar. Incident page: /incidents/INC-2026-0423

Omar: Quick triage plan: 1) canary revert of the kernel bump on pool B 2) pin Pegasus customers to older model-variant as a fallback 3) enable temporary routing fallback to pool A for affected customers. Need approval for canary revert and a 15m maintenance window for node drains.

DevEx: I have a PR to pin the model-variant (PR #4821) ready. @Maya can you give a quick review? It's a small config change and would enable immediate fallback if needed.

Maya: will review PR in ~10m. If revert is needed, infra will need oncall for drain/cordon. @SRE Bot can you confirm available window?

Elaine: customer asked for ETA. Can we commit to a temporary routing fallback within 90 minutes if canary shows regressions? @Omar pls confirm.

Omar: Routing fallback config is ready and tested in staging. If canary shows instability, I'll flip routing to pool A. Committing to ETA ~60-90m. I'll post timestamps for each step here.

Maya: reviewed PR, left one small comment about the healthcheck timeout. If that lands, rollback + pin can proceed. I'll coordinate node drain with infra. Tagging @SRE Bot for scheduling.

SRE Bot: A drain window is available. Proposed start: 1718458200 (approx +24m). Will post start/complete pings and brief outage notes to the incident page.

Elaine: thanks — I'll update the customer: routing fallback possible within 90m, canary now, will follow up with incident link.

Omar: starting canary in ~5m, will post result summary (errors, p50/p99) once done. :thumbsup:

Maya: monitoring logs and GPU metrics now. I'll escalate here immediately if p50/p99 cross thresholds.

Elaine: appreciated. If anything changes, ping the channel and update PEG-887 ticket.

Omar: canary results: initial canary stable for 3 min, small spike at t+7m but within expected. proceeding to expanded canary for 10m.

Maya: expanded canary looks stable so far. keeping watch.

Elaine: I'll relay update to customer: temporary fallback on standby, expanded canary running, ETA ~60m for full fallback if needed.

Omar: noted. If fallback is required, I'll coordinate flip and post completion here.
